name: Chiang Mai
blurb: Chiang Mai is the largest city in northern Thailand, featuring an established digital nomad economy with coworking cafes and a moated old city of temples and night markets. Online conversation regarding the destination is currently down 15% compared to its baseline.

positive: Appreciated for its vibrant street life, night markets, and local food options
Popular hub for digital nomads with numerous coworking cafes
Praised for scenic mountain views, temples, and historical sites
negative: Tuk-tuks noted for aggressively competing for customers and cutting off two-wheeled vehicles
Hotels across Thailand facing a Q3 slump as stimulus nears

quotes.text: If you ever come to Chiang Mai you should definitely hire a dtuk dtuk at least once, especially if you're visiting during Songkran. But if you're on two wheels give them a wide berth. They see every bike as a stolen customer and will not hesitate to ruin your day.
Did you know? Chiang Mai is the largest city in northern Thailand, the capital of Chiang Mai province and the second-largest city in Thailand by urban population.

⚔️ In TH: Chiang Mai Old City. A moated ancient city of temples and night markets.
